text: Hello and welcome back to another video. My name is Gary and today we'll be talking about the positive and negative implications of artificial intelligence in our daily lives. Let's dive in. For those of you who are new to this topic, let me quickly explain to you what artificial intelligence is. Artificial intelligence is a branch of science and technology that creates intelligent machines and computer programs to perform various tasks which require human intelligence as explained by Professor Fafnir Anjula. So now we have a brief idea of what artificial intelligence is, we will now begin to explore its positive and negative impacts in our daily lives. One of the benefits of using artificial intelligence is it significantly reduces human error. Humans make mistakes all the time, just think about the time when you were learning maths. Computers however do not make mistakes if they are programmed properly. With artificial intelligence mistakes and errors are significantly reduced because the decision it makes were determined by prior knowledge and it itself will remember past mistakes and ensure it does not make such mistakes again. A real-world example will be that in weather forecasting using artificial intelligence, meteorologists have reduced the majority of human error. Another positive benefit of artificial intelligence is that it strengthens the economy. In an article written by Archer Charles, AI is predicted to add more than 15 trillion to the global economy. According to a recent PWC report, progressive advances in artificial intelligence are going to drive the global GDP higher by 14% by 2030 amounting to $15.7 trillion. AI will see the highest significance and applications in the fields of robotics and healthcare. There will also be $6.6 trillion of expected growth in GDPs from games from productivity. Repetitive tasks, automation and automated chatbots and tools will remain major contributors in the years to come. This will not only increase productivity and strengthen the economy but also diversify revenue streams, improve employment and earning opportunities. According to a literature review written by Gakaya and Zundoro, one of the major advantages of artificial intelligence is that its decisions are based on facts rather than emotions. Even after our utmost efforts, it is a well-known fact that human decisions are always affected in a negative way by our emotions. Now let's talk about the negative impacts of artificial intelligence. In an article written by Nikita Duggal, there are many disadvantages of using artificial intelligence, one of them being the increase in unemployment. For example, robots are already being used to replace humans in manufacturing businesses in Japan. AI applications also make humans lazy. Why you ask? AI can automate tedious and repetitive tasks. Since we don't have to remember things or solve puzzles anymore to complete the task, we use our brain less and therefore this creates issues for further generations. AI lacks creativity. Machines just can't be as creative as humans. Although they can provide functionalities to learn from data, but they can't mimic exact human brain skills. The accuracy of the results from an AI powered machine can only depend on what data was provided to it by the creator. AI can't invent anything, it can just perform tasks it is programmed to do and improve itself. AI also lacks ethics and morals. The machines will break down or give unexpected results if it cannot find a condition that matches with that results. Hence, if we try to implement AI in places that require strong judgmental ability, it will fail. An example of this will be an AI acting as a judge. The AI will not consider any ethics and morals and will only provide answers by the book, potentially sending someone innocent to jail. In conclusion, we have explained the positives and negatives impacts of artificial intelligence in our daily lives. Who knows what AI will look like in the next 5 or 10 years.
